info.name: TGM Funder Intelligence API v1
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for the TGM Funder Intelligence API sidecar. Import this into Postman or Thunder Client.

Workflow:
1. Run 'Register Funder' — copy funder_id and api_key from response
2. Set collection variables: BASE_URL, API_KEY, FUNDER_ID
3. Run remaining endpoints in order

variable.description: Replace with your Railway deployment URL

request.description: Verify the sidecar is live. Expect 200 with status: ok.
Onboard a funder with mission, priorities, eligibility rules, and rubric. Returns funder_id and api_key. SAVE BOTH — they don't repeat.
Score a single application against the funder rubric. Returns per-criterion scores, overall score, confidence, risk score, reviewer flags, and suggested next step.

Evaluate how well an application aligns with the funder's priorities, geography, and eligibility rules. Returns fit_score, eligibility_pass/fail, why/why_not, and recommended_band (reject / review / fast-track).

request.description: Score a batch of applications for a grant cycle. Returns per-application scores, cohort analytics, shortlist (top 20%), risk clusters, alignment clusters, and bias detection signals.
Portfolio-level insights for a grant cycle. Returns shortlist suggestions, risk clusters, alignment heatmap per priority area, and over/under-funding signals.
Register a webhook URL so your portal receives TGM suggested statuses. The test_event in the response is the payload TGM will send on every score/fit call.
Retrieve your full funder record — mission, priorities, rubric, eligibility rules, and cycle configs.
